command:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp

MV=$(configManta.py --version 2>&1 | awk 'NR==1{print $1}')
TS=$(awk -F'\t' '$1=="del_start"{print $2}' truth.tsv)
TE=$(awk -F'\t' '$1=="del_end"{print $2}'   truth.tsv)
TL=$(awk -F'\t' '$1=="del_len"{print $2}'   truth.tsv)

# diagnostics written BEFORE anything can fail, so a failure still delivers evidence
{ printf 'manta_version\t%s\n' "$MV"
  printf 'mem_total_kb\t%s   (pyflow sizes its tasks from THIS, not from a cgroup limit)\n' \
    "$(awk '/MemTotal/{print $2}' /proc/meminfo)"
  printf 'nproc\t%s\n' "$(nproc)"; } > manta-diag.txt
cat manta-diag.txt
cleanup(){ cp -f wf.log manta-wf.log 2>/dev/null || :; cp -f cfg.log manta-cfg.log 2>/dev/null || :; }
trap cleanup EXIT

echo "== a SECOND caller on the SAME BAM: manta assembles candidate breakends =="
rm -rf mrun
configManta.py --bam sample.bam --referenceFasta ref.fa --runDir mrun > cfg.log 2>&1 \
  || { tail -20 cfg.log; exit 1; }
# -g is load-bearing: manta's merge task asks for 4 GiB, and pyflow refuses to schedule a
# task larger than the memory it detects. Without a box that has it, the workflow aborts.
mrun/runWorkflow.py -m local -j 2 -g 6 > wf.log 2>&1 || { tail -30 wf.log; exit 1; }
# manta writes a runDir; a directory output cannot be staged, so flatten the VCF
gzip -dc mrun/results/variants/diploidSV.vcf.gz > manta.vcf
grep -v '^##' manta.vcf | cut -f1-8

NM=$(awk '!/^#/{n++} END{print n+0}' manta.vcf)
test "$NM" = "1" || { echo "expected exactly 1 manta call, got $NM"; exit 1; }
read -r MPOS MFIL MTYPE MEND MLEN < <(awk -F'\t' '!/^#/{
  t=""; e=""; l=""
  n=split($8,a,";")
  for(i=1;i<=n;i++){ split(a[i],kv,"="); if(kv[1]=="SVTYPE")t=kv[2]; if(kv[1]=="END")e=kv[2]; if(kv[1]=="SVLEN")l=kv[2] }
  print $2, $7, t, e, l; exit }' manta.vcf)
test "$MTYPE" = "DEL"  || { echo "manta SVTYPE $MTYPE"; exit 1; }
test "$MFIL"  = "PASS" || { echo "manta FILTER $MFIL"; exit 1; }

echo "== manta END is the LAST DELETED BASE (VCF spec): deleted = POS+1 .. END =="
MS=$(( MPOS + 1 )); ME=$MEND
test "$MS" = "$TS" || { echo "manta start $MS != planted $TS"; exit 1; }
test "$ME" = "$TE" || { echo "manta end $ME != planted $TE"; exit 1; }
MABS=${MLEN#-}
test "$MABS" = "$TL" || { echo "manta |SVLEN| $MABS != deleted length $TL"; exit 1; }

echo "== delly END is the base AFTER the deletion: deleted = POS+1 .. END-1 =="
read -r DCH DPOS DFIL DTYPE DEND DLEN REST < sv.tsv
DS=$(( DPOS + 1 )); DE=$(( DEND - 1 )); DABS=${DLEN#-}

# THE SCIENCE AGREES: both callers place the same deleted interval, exactly.
test "$DS" = "$MS" || { echo "callers disagree on the start: delly $DS vs manta $MS"; exit 1; }
test "$DE" = "$ME" || { echo "callers disagree on the end: delly $DE vs manta $ME"; exit 1; }

# THE FIELDS DO NOT: a probe, so a future convention change surfaces as a failure here
test "$DEND" -ne "$MEND" || { echo "NOTE: delly and manta now report the SAME END -- conventions converged"; exit 1; }
test $(( DEND - MEND )) = 1 || { echo "END offset is $(( DEND - MEND )), expected exactly 1"; exit 1; }
test $(( DABS - MABS )) = 1 || { echo "SVLEN offset is $(( DABS - MABS )), expected exactly 1"; exit 1; }

{
printf 'Structural variants -- two independent CALLERS on one BAM\n'
printf 'manta_version\t%s\n' "$MV"
printf 'manta_calls\t%s   (assert 1 -- no false positives)\n' "$NM"
printf 'manta_type_filter\t%s / %s   (assert DEL / PASS)\n' "$MTYPE" "$MFIL"
printf 'planted_deletion\t%s-%s (%s bp)\n' "$TS" "$TE" "$TL"
printf 'manta_deleted_interval\t%s-%s   (POS+1 .. END)     assert EXACT vs planted\n' "$MS" "$ME"
printf 'delly_deleted_interval\t%s-%s   (POS+1 .. END-1)   assert EXACT vs planted\n' "$DS" "$DE"
printf 'callers_agree\tyes   (assert yes -- CROSS-VALIDATION: identical deleted interval, different algorithms)\n'
printf 'raw_END\tdelly %s vs manta %s   (differ by exactly 1 -- asserted, as a convention probe)\n' "$DEND" "$MEND"
printf 'raw_SVLEN\tdelly %s vs manta %s   (differ by exactly 1)\n' "$DLEN" "$MLEN"
printf 'note\tmanta follows the VCF spec: END is the LAST DELETED BASE and |SVLEN| is the deleted\n'
printf 'note\tlength. delly END is the base AFTER the deletion and |SVLEN| = END-POS. Both are\n'
printf 'note\tself-consistent and both recover the deletion exactly -- but ONE arithmetic cannot\n'
printf 'note\tread both. Merge them with a single formula and every delly deletion is 1 bp long\n'
printf 'note\tand fails to match its manta twin.\n'
} | tee smoke-check-manta.txt
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
